# ─── Generate lexer and parser sources ───────────────
#
# Generated files go into ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/dsl/.
# These are listed as sources of the symfind library so CMake
# tracks the dependency chain (input .y/.re → output .c/.cpp).

set(generatedDirectory "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/dsl")

# Parser: dsl/grammar.y → grammar.c + grammar.h
SymfindGenerateGrammar(
    INPUT      "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/dsl/grammar.y"
    OUTPUT_DIR "${generatedDirectory}"
)

# Lexer: dsl/lexer.re → lexer.gen.cpp
set(lexerSource "${generatedDirectory}/lexer.gen.cpp")
SymfindGenerateLexer(
    INPUT  "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/dsl/lexer.re"
    OUTPUT "${lexerSource}"
)

# ─── Main library ───────────────────────────────────
add_library(symfind STATIC
    # PE / disassembly / analysis
    pe_module.cpp
    disassembler.cpp
    function_finder.cpp
    analysis_db.cpp

    # DSL — driver and matcher (hand-written)
    dsl_driver.cpp
    dsl_matcher.cpp

    # DSL — generated by lemon and re2c
    ${parserSource}
    ${lexerSource}
)

target_include_directories(symfind
    PUBLIC
        ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/include
    PRIVATE
        # So dsl_driver.cpp can #include "grammar.h"
        ${generatedDirectory}
)

target_link_libraries(symfind
    PUBLIC
        symfind_compat
    PRIVATE
        Zydis
        LIEF::LIEF    
        spdlog::spdlog
)

target_compile_features(symfind PUBLIC cxx_std_17)

# ─── Compiler flags ─────────────────────────────────
if(MSVC)
    # Apply /W4 per source so the generated parser can use /W0 without
    # conflicting warning levels in the same compiler invocation.
    get_target_property(warningSources symfind SOURCES)
    list(REMOVE_ITEM warningSources ${parserSource})
    set_property(SOURCE ${warningSources} APPEND PROPERTY COMPILE_OPTIONS /W4)
    # Generated grammar code uses C++ types (STL, new) inside C-style file —
    # compile it as C++ and silence its warnings.
    set_source_files_properties(${parserSource}
        PROPERTIES
            LANGUAGE CXX
            COMPILE_FLAGS "/W0 /D_CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS")
else()
    target_compile_options(symfind PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic)
    set_source_files_properties(${parserSource}
        PROPERTIES
            LANGUAGE CXX
            COMPILE_FLAGS "-w")
endif()
